name: Yaya Okiba ga Nai!
source:
This is the fandisk to Okiba ga Nai!, with 4 after stories as well as a new story. The giant pure-white robot Velaltoides was returning home from a mission when he was hit by a meteorite and crashed to Earth. Unable to fly, he was stuck in Africa until the repairs are done. In the vast land, even a large robot like him could live comfortably, but he was soon confronted by a major problem: it’s too lonely! 

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/11/01/november-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
本作是《置き場がない！》的资料片，收录四篇后日谈和一篇新故事。纯白巨型机器人贝拉尔托伊德完成任务返航时遭陨石撞击，坠落地球。由于无法飞行，修复完毕前只能滞留非洲。

广袤大地足以让他这样的大型机器人舒适生活，可一个重大问题很快摆在面前：这里实在太孤独了！

[译自 [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/11/01/november-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
